item.p: Specifications: XSLT 4.0, 10.5 "Dynamic XPath Evaluation" (the xpath, context-item, with-params, namespace-context, base-uri, schema-aware and as attributes; XTDE3160, XTDE3165, XTDE3170, XTDE3175).
Unlocks: XT40 evaluate 83 cases (feature dynamic_evaluation), and the 5 XTDE3175 failures.
Replaces: the XTDE3175 raise in src/xslt_lower_control.c (evaluate_locals), and supports-dynamic-evaluation.

Mechanism: compile the XPath text at run time with the XPath front end. Its static context is built from the instruction's attributes and xsl:with-params; the parameters are external variables. Then ask the machine for a unit evaluation (), whose value is the instruction's value. No new IR kind is needed beyond what fn:load-xquery-module uses.
Owns: src/xslt_lower_control.c (the evaluate procedure) and new src/xslt_evaluate.c.
Size: about 5 KB, in the CLI only.

Gate: ≥ 90 % of the 83. Done 2026-10-19 (): evaluate 73 of 83 (91 % of the 80 run, 88 % of the 83); XT40 8,899 to 8,973 passed, 0 errors, none lost. The gate waits for 7.10 (html-doc, parse-html: 3 cases) and trust checks in json-doc and unparsed-text-available (2 cases).
